CustomField.description: Source page identifier. External Id + Unique so ingestion upserts are idempotent (re-runs update, never duplicate). Confluence used the numeric page id; the help.sdocs connector uses the page's URL path (e.g. s-sign/.../s-sign-with-pdf-upload), which can run ~150 chars - hence length 255. Field API name kept for backward compatibility.
CustomField.label: Confluence Page Id
